artworks.title: Il y a pourtant des gens qui ressemblent a ça!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two people examining a caricature of themselves on the front page of a publication. The scene depicted in the publication titled "La Caricature Provisoire" shows an elderly man and a woman with exaggerated facial features, engaged in looking at and discussing a caricature. The man is pointing at the caricature, which is featured on the cover. The artwork uses black and white lines to emphasize expressions and details. The lower portion of the image contains columns of text.

artworks.title: Voila!... un fameux temps pour les petits pois...
artworks.description: This drawing depicts two men in top hats gesturing towards each other on a street. The image shows a caricature of the individuals dressed in early 19th-century attire, with formal coats and tall top hats. They are facing each other on an urban street, with expressive hand movements and open mouths indicating possible conversation or debate. In the background, there are loosely detailed buildings suggesting a city setting. Below the drawing, there is a block of French text, resembling a newspaper or magazine page layout, titled "Les Lilas et les Près Saint-Gervais." The drawing style reflects exaggerated expressions and satirical undertones similar to the work of Honoré Daumier, known for his social and political cartoons during the 19th century.

artworks.title: Ah! ça mais... arriverons-nous bientôt?
artworks.description: This image depicts a person looking through a floor trapdoor from below. The room has a textured or patterned wall. An elderly figure stands inside the room, bent forward while holding a set of keys. Another figure is partially visible from the trapdoor, their hands clasped on the edge as they look upwards. The drawing seems to focus on the interaction between these two figures in a confined space. The title at the top is "LOCATAIRES ET PROPRIÉTAIRES," suggesting a relationship dynamic.

artworks.title: Inconvénient de demander des réparations...
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a laborer working on top of a building or large piece of furniture, another person below dealing with falling debris, and a third figure observing. The scene conveys inconvenience and unexpected challenges during repairs. The drawing style is reminiscent of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Un Déménagement furtif
artworks.description: Three men in the foreground are depicted. The two men on the sides are supporting a large coat draped over what seems to be a mannequin or a limp figure. The full bodies of the three figures are visible. The man on the left is wearing a bowler hat and a plaid scarf, looking backward with his hand gesturing. The man on the right is wearing a beret-style cap, looking forward with a focused expression. Both men are dressed in dark coats and trousers. The mannequin in the middle is adorned with an overcoat, a checked shirt, and a flat cap. In the background, an elderly-looking individual with spectacles is observing the scene from inside a lit room. The setting indicates an indoor corridor or entrance hall, mostly in shadow with light coming from the room where the observer stands.

artworks.title: Le Cordon donc!...
artworks.description: The image portrays a man looking through a window with a top hat on, and another person seated inside a dimly lit room beside a stove, wrapped in a blanket and wearing a cap.Beside the seated person is a pot on the stove, and on the wall is a poster or image.

artworks.title: Ah! il m'a donné congé...
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. One person on the left is removing wallpaper from a wall using both hands. He has a focused expression, dark disheveled hair, and is wearing a knee-length dark robe with striped pants. Two others on the right are moving a large piece of furniture, with visible legs. They are wearing short-sleeved shirts and tight-fitting pants. The background features a room with walls showing torn, patterned wallpaper and a floor with scattered ripped wallpaper pieces.

artworks.title: Inconvénient de louer... non loin d'une rivière
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking across a flooded floor. He is bent over slightly, holding a wicker basket in front of him with both hands. In his left hand, he holds a lit candle. He has a long nose, wide eyes, light-colored short hair, and wears a dark coat. His feet are half submerged in the water on the wooden floor. Water is leaking through the stone walls and ceiling in the background.

artworks.title: Je ne loue pas aux gens qui ont des enfants!
artworks.description: The image shows three people from head to toe: an elderly woman sitting in an armchair, holding a small dog on her lap, a woman standing next to her in profile view, wearing a shawl or cloak, and a young child standing next to the woman, holding onto her clothing. The elderly woman has curly hair and a stern expression, while the standing woman has tightly pulled back hair. The child is dressed in a striped outfit with short pants and looks down. Adjacent to the seated woman, there is a fireplace with a parrot on a perch above it, and a birdcage hanging on the wall behind her. On the floor, a small dog is looking up at the seated woman, while another dog is resting near the fireplace. The background features a plain wall with simple decorations, suggesting an indoor room setting.

artworks.title: C'est unique! j'ai pris quatre tailles...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man looking at a shop window display of corsets. The man is dressed in formal attire with a tall hat, leaning towards the shop window. In the image, he appears intrigued or scrutinizing the corsets displayed on shelves. The drawing portrays a humorous or satirical tone commonly found in illustrations depicting everyday scenes with a hint of caricature. The background shows an interior space where the man, holding a walking stick, is positioned confidently. The corsets on the shelves are detailed, emphasizing their shape and structure. The artwork appears to be a print or a lithograph based on its style and the signature at the bottom, giving it a historical artistic quality.

artworks.title: Ah! Excusez
artworks.description: This is an image showing two figures in a humorous and exaggerated scenario with a large wooden plank. One figure steps backward with a startled expression as they are hit in the face by the plank being carried by the other figure. The person's face is mostly obscured by the plank. The setting seems to be an interior space with a wood-paneled or stage-like environment. The artwork features exaggerated expressions and postures, typical of caricature art styles.

artworks.title: La Queue au spectacle
artworks.description: This is a drawing of anthropomorphized figures standing in the snow. The scene shows figures in winter attire standing outside a venue behind a barrier. Snowflakes are visible in the air. The figures seem to be engaged in various interactions, with expressive expressions. The style of the illustration suggests a humorous or critical intent.

artworks.title: L'Eau du puits de Grenelle
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of two men in a satirical style. The man on the left is drinking from a large glass container. He has a pronounced nose, thin lips, and slicked-back hair. He wears a dark coat over a light-colored shirt. The man on the right has a skeptical facial expression, with pursed lips, peering eyes, round spectacles, and disheveled hair. He wears a dark suit with a bow tie. He holds a glass in one hand and rests the other hand on his hip. Both men are set against a lightly shaded background with the word "ACTUALITÉS" displayed at the top.

artworks.title: Surveillant la Commission de Surveillance
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure with a cane standing in front of a building labeled "B.C.E.P. Nationale." The figure, dressed in a long dark coat or cloak and a wide-brimmed hat, appears to be striking a dramatic pose while holding a cane in one hand. The building in the background has a columned facade. There is a tall, thin figure in uniform and cap standing by a fence in front of the building. The title "Surveillant la Commission de Surveillance" and the word "Actualités" are printed at the top. The use of bold lines and shading provides depth and character to the scene.

artworks.title: Le Retour de l'age d'or
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting three figures adorned with nature motifs. The drawing features three figures wearing foliage or flowers as headpieces. The first figure is large and is winding a horn. The second figure is seated and holding a bunch of grapes. The third figure is slender and in a dynamic pose. The drawing is rendered in a caricature style with exaggerated features and expressions. The background includes a tree and open land.

artworks.title: Malheureux! tu veux donc tuer le père de tes enfants?
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures in a room. On the left, a man in a military uniform stands holding a sword. He wears a tall hat and has exaggerated facial features and long hair. The woman on the right looks surprised, with her arm reaching back towards a table set with plates, glasses, and a bottle. In the background, there is a wall with a small framed picture.

artworks.title: Onze degrés centigrades!
artworks.description: The image shows two men in exaggerated side profiles. Both lean towards each other with bent knees. One man has his arms tucked under a cape, while the other has his hands in his pockets. The men have caricature-like facial features with pronounced noses and thin mouths. They wear sophisticated yet exaggerated attire, including a cape and a coat, each topped with a tall hat. The clothing suggests an older fashion style with striped trousers. There are no visible accessories. The background features a sketched cityscape.

artworks.title: Charmé de se voir exposé...
artworks.description: The image shows a satirical illustration of four people standing in a salon, observing a painting. The painting features a person with a bulbous forehead and solemn expression, similar to one of the individuals in the group below. The man with the bulbous forehead is at the center, facing the viewer directly, while the others surround him, wearing headgear; a woman with a bonnet and two men with top hats. The central figure has prominent eyebrows, pouting lips, and dark hair styled in a short, round fashion. Their attire is formal, consistent with 19th-century fashion. The background has frames and wall decorations typical of a gallery. There is a piece of script below the figures indicating dialogue or commentary on the perceived likeness between the man and the portrait.

artworks.title: Quand on est possesseur de cent actions...
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting on a large, gnarled tree branch. The man has a long, narrow face, a prominent nose, unkempt hair, and a pensive expression. He wears a long-sleeved shirt, dark pants, shoes, and a loose necktie hanging around his neck. In front of him, a noose hangs from another branch. The background shows a distant landscape with subtle details portraying buildings or a city skyline. The image is in a monochrome, hand-drawn style with French text at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Décadence du drame en 1866
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a theater setting, captured from the waist up. They are seated closely together, facing towards the viewer as if sitting in an audience. The individuals depicted in the foreground have distinct exaggerated facial features, with one person prominently on the left appearing to lean to the side, mouth agape, while another on the right holds a handkerchief to their face. The hair of these individuals varies, with some appearing disheveled or tousled. Their clothing is detailed with emphasis on shading to highlight jackets and shirts, typical of mid-19th-century fashion. No jewelry or other distinct objects are visible. The background consists of more people seated in rows, blending into a dark, shadowy ambiance, which conveys a crowded theater environment. The use of lines and shading suggests an enclosed space with dim lighting, typical of a theater's interior.

artworks.title: Madame Cabassol se promène...
artworks.description: The image shows three people and a deer in a garden setting. Two men in long coats, trousers, and hats face each other. The man on the left has his hands behind his back, short hair, and a sharp nose. The man on the right holds the arm of a woman standing beside him. The woman wears a long dress with patterns, a shawl on her head, and holds a cane. A deer stands between the two men. Background elements include a fence, trees, and clouds. The illustration is monochromatic with detailed shading.

artworks.title: Je t'ai déjà défendu de m'appeler maitre...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a confrontation between two individuals. The artwork features one figure kicking another from behind in an interior setting. A painting is partially visible on the wall, and there is a curtain on the right side. The figure on the left is in mid-motion and appears to be exerting force, causing the other figure to move forward with a surprised expression. The scene includes text below the drawing hinting at a social commentary. The artwork is rendered in a monochromatic palette with line work that adds intensity to the moment depicted.

artworks.title: La Carotte de l'élection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man greeting a rustic family. The man is well-dressed, wearing a tall top hat and holding a cane, reaching out for a handshake with another man who is more casually dressed. The second man is accompanied by a smiling woman and a child. The setting appears rural, with simple structures and a fence in the background. The title of the drawing is "La Carotte de l'Élection," hinting at a theme of persuasion or influence in an election.

artworks.title: Un Faux vase du Japon faisant...
artworks.description: The image shows four people in a detailed illustration. Three men and a woman are depicted. The men have distinctive facial features with lined faces and exaggerated expressions, including one wearing glasses. They have short, slicked-back hair and are dressed in formal attire. The woman is seated at a round table, observing a vase in her hands. She has her hair in a bun and is wearing a patterned blouse and a long skirt. Additional items are on the table. The background features faint sketches of walls and paintings, suggesting an interior setting.
